name: BenchQC
description: A toolkit for benchmarking quantum computation performance across devices and simulators.
evaluation_method: Device and simulator performance metrics such as circuit fidelity, error rates, execution time, and composite benchmarks (e.g., Quantum Volume)
general_score_metric: circuit fidelity / Quantum Volume and reported error rates
reputation: Tooling used by quantum researchers and practitioners for standardized device/simulator comparisons; moderate adoption within the quantum computing community.
notes: Results are hardware- and calibration-dependent; cross-device comparisons require careful normalization. Simulator fidelity vs hardware introduces confounders. Small-number statistics and temporal variability in device performance can affect reproducibility.
